Subject: Request to shift demo — Solstice FY planning / travel conflicts

Marissa —

Quick update from our side: we're entering a temporary spend hold across a few BU teams as the finance group closes Q2 and reconciles vendor commitments. On top of that, our head of engineering (who was slated to join the demo) is traveling overseas the week of 6/29 and won't be available for deep technical Q&A.

We really want to see Redwood in action, but can we push the full demo until after our FY planning window — ideally the week of July 12 or later? If possible, we'd like a short 20-minute touchpoint this week just to review the demo agenda so we don't lose momentum. Procurement will also want visibility into an SOW/PO timeline and a simple procurement checklist from you.

Apologies for the churn — we want to get this right but need to align with internal budget timing.

Thanks,
Ben
VP, Product & Engineering
Solstice Health

Ben — thanks for the heads up and totally understand the timing constraints. Appreciate the context on the travel and the finance window.

Proposed next steps:
- Move the full technical demo to the week of July 12. Two good candidate slots from our calendar: Tue 2026-07-13 11:00 AM ET or Mon 2026-07-12 11:00 AM ET — happy to lock whichever works best for your team.
- Short 20-minute pre-demo touchpoint this Friday (6/26) or early next week to confirm agenda and attendees — we can keep it light and only include Rishi and Monica from our side.
- I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines milestones (demo, security review, procurement, PO). It also lists the standard docs procurement requests: SOC 2 link, network/ingress notes, and estimated lead times for pilot provisioning.

If you confirm a preferred July slot I will send a calendar invite and update the MAP with target PO dates tied to your FY reset.

Warmly,

Team — quick note from my side: agree with pushing the full demo to mid-July. Given the spend freeze window, offer a pragmatic incentive to keep Solstice engaged: one-week free pilot credits (applied after PO) and a commitment to prioritize capacity for their pilot next month.

Please ensure the MAP includes the following procurement items explicitly:
- SOC 2 Type II report link (we can share via Drive link)
- Standard data-handling summary and retention matrix (1 pager)
- Expected provisioning lead time (we can commit 5 business days for pilot once PO is received)
- Primary legal and procurement contacts at Redwood (for PO routing)

Marissa / Rishi — call this out in the follow-up to Solstice and offer to have Monica join the rescheduled demo for the technical deep-dive. Aim for PO signature by 2026-07-31 in the MAP so procurement can track in their FY plans.

Vivek
